status_axes.completion_meaning: The assignment (one circuit, up to three devices, hot Rds from primary sources, P_additional, bracket comparison) was carried out. FINISHED is not PASS, SELECTED, VALIDATED or QUALIFIED.
status_axes.numerical_meaning: Only the contract relation P_saved = P_bridge - 450*R_hot - P_additional was evaluated. No solver, no model, no CAD edit.
status_axes.checker_meaning: The dispatch marks checker_revision_and_sha256 not_applicable and issues no checker, so no checker receipt exists to report.
status_axes.hardware_qualification_meaning: No bench work, no procurement, no physical or thermal qualification was performed or claimed.
status_axes.assembly_rank_meaning: Source-only partial result: no assembly rank is emitted.

inputs_frozen.r_hot_basis: per device, typical, at the stated Tj

beats_pre_additional_break_even.IPW60R017C7: YES across the entire 51-78 mOhm band and at every evaluated Tj up to 150 C. Hot typ 24.8-33.0 mOhm vs break-even 51.1 mOhm (low) to 77.8 mOhm (high); margin 18.1-44.8 mOhm below the break-even, i.e. 8.1-20.1 W saved across the bridge bracket at the worst Tj (150 C), and 11.8-23.8 W at 100 C.
beats_pre_additional_break_even.NVHL040N60S5F: PARTIAL / Tj-DEPENDENT. Hot typ 55.6 mOhm at 100 C and 66.1 mOhm at 125 C are inside the 51-78 mOhm band: it beats only the high-bridge-loss end. Nominal P_saved +3.3 W at 100 C and -1.4 W at 125 C; at the 23 W bracket end it loses (-2.0 W at 100 C).
beats_pre_additional_break_even.STW65N65DM2AG: NO. Hot typ 72.7 mOhm at 100 C is only just inside the band, and 86.1 mOhm at 125 C exceeds 77.8 mOhm: it beats no part of the band at 125 C. Nominal P_saved -4.4 W at 100 C and -10.4 W at 125 C.

answer: YES, a worthwhile active-rectifier opportunity exists for at least one concrete device class: a 600 V CoolMOS C7 (IPW60R017C7-order device) driven by an NXP TEA2209T four-MOSFET active bridge has a hot per-device Rds(on) of about 25-33 mOhm from 100-150 C, below the 51-78 mOhm pre-additional break-even across the whole bridge bracket, saving roughly 8-24 W (nominal 13-17 W) before the unquantified P_additional terms. A mid-Rds 600/650 V device (40-50 mOhm at 25 C) is marginal and Tj-dependent and the retained board part STW65N65DM2AG shows no opportunity.

single_missing_input.input: The real operating junction temperature of the bridge MOSFETs under the actual thermal path.
single_missing_input.why: It selects which datasheet hot Rds(on) applies, and it is the only input that moves the mid-range candidates across the 51-78 mOhm break-even (C2 goes from +3.3 W to -1.4 W nominal between 100 C and 125 C). The low-Rds candidate wins at every evaluated temperature up to the datasheet's 150 C row, so the top-level 'opportunity exists' answer is robust to it; what remains unresolved is which device class is acceptable and the size of the saving.
